false_reactivation_definition: At an actual REACTIVATE_OLD, current one-to-one IoU-matched GT differs from last GT-matched observation for that candidate ID before this frame/view commit. Unknown GT/prefix is unassessed, not counted false.
native_bank_semantics: last bank_size raw-ReID write samples at first appearance in any logged old_reid_ids; persistent until reactivated; only GT labels attached offline
wrong_commit_definition: Final committed existing ID changes its last observed GT identity across key boundary; observational prefix conflict, not counterfactual action utility.
